bestSellers.title: Product Search
bestSellers.subtitle: Browse Amazon's top lists, tick the products you want and send them to Add Listings in one step.
bestSellers.allowanceHint: Every product you see counts once per period; the same list opened again today is not counted twice.

locked.title_one: {{count}} more product on this page is outside your plan's monthly allowance
locked.title_other: {{count}} more products on this page are outside your plan's monthly allowance
locked.description: Upgrade your plan or buy a top-up pack to see them. Your allowance renews with each billing period.

loading.title: Loading the list
loading.description: Fetching the latest ranking from Amazon.

empty.title: No products on this page
empty.description: This list has nothing to show here. Try another category or list.

noMatches.title: No product matches your filters
noMatches.description: Loosen a filter to see more of this list. Filters apply to the products on this page.

notFound.title: This category is not available
notFound.description: Amazon does not offer this list for the chosen category. Go back to all categories or pick another one.

blocked.title: Amazon did not answer this time
blocked.description: The list could not be read just now. Try again in a moment.

unavailable.title: Best Sellers is temporarily unavailable
unavailable.description: The list service is not reachable right now. Your listings and orders are not affected.

disabled.title: Best Sellers is not enabled on this account
disabled.description: Browsing Amazon lists is switched off for your account. Contact support if you expected to see it.

limitReached.title: Too many live list loads today
limitReached.description: Lists already loaded today are still available — switch to one of them, or try again tomorrow.

errors.disabled: Best Sellers is not enabled on this account.
errors.dailyLimitReached: Too many live list loads today. Try again tomorrow.
